big: An anxious client, near retirement, wants a complex long-short product because it sounds clever. A good adviser declines. Suitability comes before any product, and a SIF is for a specific investor.

lines: Someone whose goals, risk capacity and understanding fit it, and who invests only surplus capital: money left after the emergency fund and goals are funded. Tax depends on the asset mix and holding period, and rules change, so check the latest. Read the scheme document first.

note: Tax: an equity-heavy and a debt-heavy SIF strategy are taxed differently. Confirm current rules.
